[Intro]
[Verse]
Tracing shadows on a dusty road
Searching for a spark to light the soul
Every question hanging in the silent air
Finding pieces of a truth I share

The heavy clouds begin to rise

Underneath the vast and open sky

[Chorus]

Underneath the vast and open sky
Every heartbeat finds its steady home

In the stillness, I hear your call
Every shadow starts to fall
[Chorus]
Break the chains and let me fly
Underneath the vast and open sky
Every heartbeat finds its steady home
No more walking this path alone
[Outro]
